cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before we renew this lease, do you want my honest answer about living together or a peaceful dinner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your honest answer. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I can't promise both. Shall I answer, or shall we order?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Answer. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the answer you're choosing for me. Do you still want mine?
